queries:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT p.birth_country AS country, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM player_college pc
  JOIN player p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.birth_country
),
t AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total, AVG(cnt) AS mean_cnt FROM c
)
SELECT
  SUM(c.cnt) AS sum_counts,
  AVG(c.cnt * 1.0 / t.total) AS mean_share,
  AVG(c.cnt - t.mean_cnt) AS mean_diff
FROM c, t
WHERE c.cnt > t.mean_cnt;
SELECT birth_country, COUNT(*) AS total_players, AVG(height) AS avg_height
FROM player
WHERE birth_country IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY birth_country;
SELECT birth_country FROM player GROUP BY birth_country HAVING COUNT(*) >= (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player GROUP BY birth_country));
SELECT CAST(COUNT(pc.player_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.birth_country) AS avg_college_records_per_country
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN player_college pc ON p.player_id = pc.player_id;
